tweets: Virupaksha Temple, Hampi — continuous worship here for over 1,300 years, since at least the 7th century. Śiva is enshrined as Virupaksha, consort of the local goddess Pampā — whose name, softened over centuries, gave Hampi its own.

The temple predates the Vijayanagara empire that later rose around it, and outlasted its fall in 1565 — when much of Hampi was sacked, Virupaksha's worship continued unbroken. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history
